data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2018 year of account reassumed via 2020 quota share
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2018 year of account liabilities were reassumed by Syndicate 6134 as part of the 2020 quota share agreement; the 2020 amounts include these reassumed liabilities.

named_events.loss_description: According to numerous estimates of the insured damage, will result in around US$50 to US$65 billion worth of claims. Syndicate 6134 was not impacted by Hurricane Ian as much as the host syndicate as the majority of losses were in classes that the syndicate does not reinsure.

Russia's unprovoked invasion and continued aggression against the Ukraine caused wide-ranging effects within the insurance market and economic turmoil, with long-term effects to be realised over many years.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 185.764m. During 2022 there was an overall favourable movement on prior years' reserves of GBP 3.1m (a release), driven by favourable development on property reinsurance (GBP 4.3m) and marine reinsurance (GBP 0.3m) partially offset by adverse development on casualty reinsurance (GBP 1.5m). The net effect was a modest release of reserves representing approximately a 1.7% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which states an overall improvement of GBP 3.1m. The note does not explicitly label the figure as gross or net in the sentence, but it is presented in the movement note and used here as gross per the report structure. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and consistent with technical provisions. Some mapping (e.g. marine -> Reinsurance - Specialty) reflects that movements were described as 'reinsurance' lines.
